medications.duration: Titrate to 5‑10 mg as tolerated over 4‑6 weeks, then lifelong – review annually
medications.purpose: Renin‑angiotensin‑aldosterone system blockade to reduce proteinuria and control hypertension in CKD
medications.nice_justification: NG203 first‑line ACE‑I/ARB for CKD with proteinuria or hypertension; monitor creatinine & potassium after 1‑2 weeks

medications.purpose: Cardiovascular risk reduction in CKD (risk equivalent)
medications.nice_justification: NG203 recommends statin for all CKD patients for CV risk reduction

medications.duration: If BP >140/90 mmHg after maximising ACE‑I, continue lifelong – review BP every 3 months
medications.purpose: Additional antihypertensive to achieve target BP <140/90 mmHg
medications.nice_justification: NG203 advises adding a non‑ACE‑I antihypertensive when BP remains uncontrolled

contraindications.alternative: Paracetamol or topical agents for osteoarthritis pain

assumptions_warnings: Baseline serum potassium and creatinine required before initiating ramipril and after each dose change (NG203).
Baseline liver function tests required before starting atorvastatin (NG203).

treatment_summary: Start low‑dose ramipril and high‑intensity atorvastatin for renoprotection and cardiovascular risk reduction, monitor renal function and electrolytes, avoid contraindicated drugs, and add a calcium‑channel blocker if blood pressure remains uncontrolled; provide lifestyle advice and arrange follow‑up in 2‑4 weeks.
